svg.title: The package workshop
svg.desc: Five public projects send packages to a NixOS snowflake assembler. Traffic reflects indexed authored commits from September 20 through October 19, 2026. Assembly is illustrative and does not represent CI results.
svg.text: A MONTH OF WORK, MADE TANGIBLE
Five projects keep the workshop moving.
One snowflake, assembled piece by piece.
Public commit activity · illustrative assembly, not CI status
